notes.title: Male Puppet Patch - Update v1.54.1
notes.content:
Male Puppet Patch - Update v1.54

This update patch for Virt-U-Mate includes newly added full bone weight puppet control to the Male character that works in conjunction with the newly added Male sexual position animations. 

We have also fixed the AO map issue with the male character so that his crotch skin rendering matches the rest of the skin tone without any unwanted shadows.

notes.title: iOS Patch Update v1.54.1
notes.content:
In the last animation update patch we made an error resulting in the iOS version of Virt-U-Mate build being updated with 0 bytes. This error has been resolved and the iOS build Update v1.54.1 now correctly matches the Windows version already available online. 

Thanks to users who reported this error with the MAC build.

notes.title: New Sex Position Animations Added - Update v1.54
notes.content:
New Sex Position Animations Added - Update v1.54

Many users mentioned that positioning of the Male character with the IK rigs was too cumbersome and required difficult setup for interaction with the Female partner. In light on this, we're added a complete Male animation set that can be selected from the position menu to better help with quick and easy positioning and interactions with both characters. 

We'll be looking to make IK adjustments an option for both characters, but for now this will make the game more enjoyable for all and much easier to use and get the results in scene that most players are looking for. 

All new positions are located in the Actress position menu when the Male character has been activated in the Visual Settings menu.
